changelog:
Initial release of English Reading Coach — an interactive tutor for core English reading strategies.

- Teaches and drills seven key reading strategies with real texts from trusted ESL sources.
- Explicitly models and explains each strategy before guiding practice and feedback.
- Provides full interactive sessions: passage selection, strategy teaching, practice, feedback, vocabulary, and challenge.
- Adapts to learner’s level, goals, and text preferences.
- Includes structured session flow and daily reading drill at B2–C1 level with quality native-register sources.
- Designed for active, strategy-based reading improvement and exam preparation.
summary: An interactive coach teaching and drilling seven core English reading strategies with real ESL texts to improve comprehension and active reading skills.
